description: This file defines the TransactionAgentStatistics class, which implements the ITransactionAgentStatistics interface. It tracks transaction metrics such as started, successful, failed, and throttled transactions using counters, and provides methods to increment these metrics and copy statistics.

classes.name: TransactionAgentStatistics
classes.description: Implements ITransactionAgentStatistics; tracks transaction metrics via counters.

methods.name: TransactionAgentStatistics
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the counters for transaction metrics.

methods.name: TrackTransactionStarted
methods.description: Increments the counter for started transactions.

methods.name: TrackTransactionSucceeded
methods.description: Increments the counter for successful transactions.

methods.name: TrackTransactionFailed
methods.description: Increments the counter for failed transactions.

methods.name: TrackTransactionThrottled
methods.description: Increments the counter for throttled transactions.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the given ITransactionAgentStatistics object.
